dedupe_keys.name: semanticrail3d railway point cloud segmentation dataset version 2

description: SemanticRail3D supplies labelled mobile-LiDAR railway corridors for semantic and instance segmentation. Arshia Ghasemlou and collaborators at Universidade de Vigo publish a version-2 archive with LAZ point clouds and documented training, validation and test partitions. The original collection is described as 438 sections of 200 metres and about 2.8 billion points. Version 2 divides sections into five parts and removes problematic segments. Point attributes include local coordinates, intensity, semantic class and instance identifier. The acquisition location and calendar period are not established in the inspected metadata; reported density is about 980 points per square metre. Zenodo provides free public access under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is inconsistent class and section counts across documentation: the archive page says 11 classes, while the README says 12 and alternates between 437 and 438 original sections. These differences require resolution before reproducing a benchmark split. Simulation uses include deriving railway asset geometry and testing perception components for inspection or digital twins. No related catalogue resource was established as a direct input. The archive was not downloaded and label quality was not independently evaluated.
name: SemanticRail3D railway point-cloud segmentation dataset, version 2
